title: Kidnapped
author: Cleril
description:
You're three years old and you're going to be kidnapped. Such is your circumstance. You can do nothing about it, for now.

Kidnapped is a text-only Interactive Fiction where you attempt to escape from your circumstance of having just been kidnapped. Play as a boy or a girl and freely explore an entire house, desperately trying to find a way to escape. Maybe you'll make a friend. Maybe you'll get a little bloody.

Maybe you can't do anything at all to escape your circumstances.
